title: chore(objectui): move the console pin from 5e15928b4631 to 0707b4ae3712, the newest green objectui main
body:
Fixes #24283
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `5e15928b4631` to `0707b4ae3712`. That is objectui `main` at `0707b4ae37120d45d6401170666a0b76cb7a3546` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12950), the newest objectui `main` commit that was green at the move. The maintainer ruled 「要升级就升最新」 (`6247729493`), so the target is the newest green commit, and the card's `32b492b67` is a floor, not the target.

This PR is not a release act. The Version Packages PR #24168 is not touched, and no release workflow is dispatched.

**Tier:** not governed. All 5 paths are outside the governed register (`.changeset/`, `.objectui-sha`, `packages/sdui-parser/`, `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, `sdui.manifest.json`). Size: 5 files, +129 / -9.

## Choosing the pin

- **The green reading** was taken by the dispatching seat (`domain:devx` seat 1, `session_01VwoC2RxFfgzY2eXuC7Xo6g`) over REST on `repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/commits/SHA/check-runs`, at **2026-10-18T10:22Z**:
  - `eee54ed79ea8` (the tip by then): 18 checks still in progress.
  - `3da39ae4298e`: 7 in progress and 1 cancelled.
  - `0707b4ae3712`: 100 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure. **Completed green, and the newest such commit.**
  - This dev session could not read objectui's API from its container (the request was refused for an unattached repository), so the seat took the reading. The blocked report and the hand-off are on the card.
- **The bump** ran at **2026-10-18T10:24:57Z**: `scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit 0707b4ae37120d45d6401170666a0b76cb7a3546`. It answered "5e15928b4631 → 0707b4ae3712 (on origin/main)".
- **Ancestors.** I checked these with `git merge-base --is-ancestor X 0707b4ae3712` in a fresh objectui clone. Every one exits 0, and an exit 0 proves itself even in a partial clone. The seat's REST `compare` agrees, with `eee54ed79ea8` reading `behind 2` as its control.

  | objectui commit | what it ships | waiting here |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | `d637be321` (objectui PR #12921) | a print record page draws the record's header actions beside Print | #8346 |
  | `8523e81db` (objectui PR #12923) | the read-only line-items table prints display text | #8346 |
  | `32b492b67` (objectui PR #12937) | boolean and file line cells print in the session language | #8346 |
  | `54e79f989` (objectui PR #12914, objectui#12854) | `record:line_items` hydrates an untyped column from the child field | #24190 |
  | `fb501bc89` (objectui PR #12944, objectui#12941) | an `operation: 'update'` action posts only its collected params | #24268 |
  | `044f23193` (objectui PR #12901) | a slotted page template draws only the regions it places | (in the range) |
  | `5e15928b4631` | the previous pin | n/a |

- **Spec floor.** objectui `03f1d6528` (PR #12948) and `641dad4b3` (PR #12945) raise `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s and `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `@objectstack/spec` floor to `^18.0.0-next.3`. This tree's workspace `packages/spec` is `18.0.0-next.3`, which satisfies the floor. The console build below compiled against it.
- **Range** `5e15928b4631..0707b4ae3712`: 67 non-merge commits.

## Gate (a): Console Pin Gate, local equivalent

I ran the same procedure as PR #24144:

1. Client closure: `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@objectstack/client --filter=@objectstack/sdui-parser --filter=@objectstack/spec`. 34/34 tasks passed, `VERDICT command-exit 0` under the verify lock.
2. `pnpm objectui:build` (`scripts/build-console.sh`) at the new pin, under the verify lock, ended with `VERDICT command-exit 0`:
   - bundle canary `import/jobs` present;
   - exactly one zod version literal, `{major:4,minor:6,patch:7}`;
   - "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it" (7 of 7 injected-only descriptions present, 1 of 1 published-only absent);
   - "@objectstack/console dist ready (65172 KB) from objectui@0707b4ae3712".
3. `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` reads `0707b4ae37120d45d6401170666a0b76cb7a3546`.
   - `pnpm check:console-sha` reads "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@0707b4ae3712)".
   - `pnpm check:console-injection` passes.
   - Both exit 0.

That build ran before the manifest was regenerated, so it warned that the shipped copy of `sdui.manifest.json` named `5e15928b4631`. The tracked file is now regenerated (below). `packages/console/dist/` is untracked, and CI builds it fresh.

## The second half: manifest and lockstep record

- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` read `.cache/objectui-0707b4ae3712/apps/console` and wrote 107 components (sha256 `c75bf93c6c71…`). It also re-recorded `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` at the pin, with `@object-ui/core` 17.7.0.
- `sdui.manifest.json` changes in one component. `element:definition-list`'s `items` description now says an empty list draws the active language's "No data" (`common.noData`), not "No details". This comes from objectui `2cfdc99df` (objectui PR #12919), which is in the range. No component is added or removed.
- `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-0707b4ae3712 pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` re-recorded `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` at the pin.
  - Before the re-record, `check:sdui-lockstep` reported one `pin-moved` finding (exit 1).
  - After it, the gate passes (exit 0). The grammar blob `0131f27cf86d` and the predicate blob `76c18fb95d1f` are unchanged (214 grammar lines, 25 codes, 7 sources), so no parser port is owed.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exits 0. It confirms `@object-ui 17.7.0` from the objectui checkout. Its `--self-test` passes 13 cases.

## Spec Shape Gate and pin citations

No gate asked for either. The Spec Shape Gate compiles objectui `main`, not `.objectui-sha`, and its trigger does not match these paths. No spec docblock citation is edited, and no registry row is added.

## The console changeset

`.changeset/24283-console-pin-0707b4ae3712.md` was written by `scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit` and renamed to this card's prefix.

- `@objectstack/console` **minor**: 84 releasing changesets across 67 non-merge commits, 2 annotated breaking, 1 release-nothing, and 1 commit without a changeset (`5ec2175fd`, docs only).
- The script's ADR-0087 placeholder is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Each breaking entry is answered against this tree:
  - `32b492b67` (`@object-ui/plugin-form`): the exported `deriveDetail` / `deriveColumns` now require a `booleanLabel` argument. These are objectui functions, no package in this tree imports `@object-ui/plugin-form`, and the stored boolean values are unchanged.
  - `c999d4c01` (`@object-ui/types`): a form select option carrying `kind` or `default` is refused. `FormSelectOptionSchema` in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` already leaves out both keys and refuses them by name.
- The body carries `Clause-②: no`, as the precedent pin changeset does.
- `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` and `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` all exit 0.

## Verification, at `435946d3`

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (no paths, merge base `d537a318b`) derived 72 commands. I ran each one and captured its exit code before any pipe. 70 exited 0 on the first run.
- Two exited 3 (prerequisite not met), the same two as on PR #24144:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: its fixture commit `621a48760` was outside the shallow clone. After `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a48760…` it passed 48 cases (exit 0).
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: it needs a full build. `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=!@objectstack/docs` passed 76/76, and the gate then passed (111 entries, 69 packages, exit 0).
- `--ran` with exit codes reads "72 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)".
- This PR changes no package source, so no package `test` / `typecheck` is owed.

## What this pin unblocks

- **#8346** (PDF / print chain): the three print fixes `d637be321`, `8523e81db` and `32b492b67` reach an installable console once this lands.
- **#24190**: `54e79f989` (objectui#12854) is in the pin.
- **#24268**: its objectui half, `fb501bc89` (objectui#12941), is in the pin.
- #8346, #24190 and #24268 remain open. Each is re-read after this lands.

## Acceptance notes

- objectui `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` still ledgers `marketplace:installed-list` as `EMPTY SPEC SHAPE` at this pin. The spec here already retires the type by name (#24230), and that entry's own note says the spec retiring it makes the entry RETIRED UPSTREAM. Moving it is an objectui-side change, so it is not part of this pin move. The fix belongs to an objectui PR that the next pin hop will carry.
- objectui `main` has moved on (`3da39ae4298e`, `eee54ed79ea8`), and those commits were still running CI when the seat read them. They go with the next hop.
- The red `Showcase Smoke` (#24288) is not this card's. `examples/app-showcase/e2e/**` is not touched.
